audit_items.proof_trace: Every state-mutating entry point calls ensure_version_matches() before any mutation: deposit (L41), borrow (L44), withdraw (L45), repay (L42), liquidate via pre_liquidation_check (L55), flash_loan (L47/72/105), enter_market_inner (L42), claim_reward (L40), all admin entry points, and referral functions. The only function that omits ensure_version_matches is version_admin::migrate, which intentionally uses a different check (self.version < CURRENT_VERSION) to enable the upgrade itself. Query-only functions mutate no state and satisfy the property vacuously.
